title: case 语句的三种实现 / Implementing case statements

checks.name: density policy: dense -> jump table, 3 arms -> linear, sparse -> binary search
jump tables everywhere: 77 comparisons but 15011 table words
binary search over unsorted keys: k = 1 and the 10 lookup fall to else
adjacent tables with range check: selector 5 takes else in both
no range check: selector 5 jumps into the second statement's table, silently skipping output

always-linear.reason: linear search for every case statement
always-linear.explain: 全部线性查找：结果对，但比较次数随分支数线性增长，落到 else 的选择子要把每个键都比一遍。

always-jump.reason: jump table for every case statement, however sparse
always-jump.explain: 稀疏的键（1..5000 里只有 6 个）也建跳转表：比较次数最少，但表有 5000 个字。

binary-unsorted.reason: wrong: binary search over the keys in source order
binary-unsorted.explain: 二分查找要求键有序；按源码顺序二分，k = 1 被引到错误的一半，静默落进 else。

no-range-check.reason: wrong: index the jump table without checking the selector range
no-range-check.explain: 不做范围检查：k = 5 越过第一张表的末尾，读到的是紧挨着的第二张表的第一项，于是跳进了第二个 case 的分支，中间的输出全被跳过，程序不报错。
